Selected original SVG files are retained in icons/. Symbol bodies are inlined
with existing project identifiers and style inheritance. The neutral 28x28 PNG
and generator paint bodies adapt the image.svg outline into the legacy raster
renderer, using a neutral gray. This is an adaptation, not the platform logos.
Original first-party software and other asset licenses remain separate.
The selected archive is hash-matched to official registry metadata; registry
signatures/Trusted Publishing attestations were not independently verified.
